queries.01-repository-summary:
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX mnp: <https://yangjunjie-lin.github.io/KG-MNP-Demo/ontology/terms#>
SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?g) AS ?namedGraphCount) (COUNT(*) AS ?quadCount) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?s) AS ?subjectCount) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?p) AS ?predicateCount) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?o) AS ?objectCount) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?s ?p ?o } }
queries.02-named-graph-counts:
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX mnp: <https://yangjunjie-lin.github.io/KG-MNP-Demo/ontology/terms#>
SELECT ?g (COUNT(*) AS ?count) WHERE { GRAPH ?g { ?s ?p ?o } } GROUP BY ?g ORDER BY ?g

SELECT ?s ?p ?o WHERE { GRAPH <urn:kg-mnp:graph:abox:a952de54abc91ebfbeea0496ac11ccc9a29e988972500fe78e20ff4b6112dfdc> { ?s ?p ?o . FILTER(?p IN (<http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#domain>, <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#range>, <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subClassOf>, <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subPropertyOf>, <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#disjointWith>, <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#equivalentClass>, <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#equivalentProperty>) || (?p = <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> && ?o IN (<http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#Class>, <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#DatatypeProperty>, <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#ObjectProperty>, <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#NodeShape>, <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#PropertyShape>))) } } ORDER BY ?s ?p ?o
queries.04-provenance-coverage:
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX mnp: <https://yangjunjie-lin.github.io/KG-MNP-Demo/ontology/terms#>
SELECT ?s ?p ?o WHERE { GRAPH <urn:kg-mnp:graph:abox:a952de54abc91ebfbeea0496ac11ccc9a29e988972500fe78e20ff4b6112dfdc> { ?s ?p ?o . FILTER(!(?p = rdf:type && ?o = owl:Ontology) && ?p != owl:imports) FILTER NOT EXISTS { GRAPH <urn:kg-mnp:graph:modeling-provenance:a952de54abc91ebfbeea0496ac11ccc9a29e988972500fe78e20ff4b6112dfdc> { ?assertion a owl:Axiom ; owl:annotatedSource ?s ; owl:annotatedProperty ?p ; owl:annotatedTarget ?o ; mnp:hasReviewDecision ?decision } } } } ORDER BY ?s ?p ?o
queries.05-review-audit-coverage:

FILTER(?extraLog != <urn:kg-mnp:review-decision-log:3525af7fbc16fd7c5d5e12dcbd19ebf4610c6727ec516739e28d33e3c6e9af98>) } } FILTER NOT EXISTS { GRAPH <urn:kg-mnp:graph:review-audit:a952de54abc91ebfbeea0496ac11ccc9a29e988972500fe78e20ff4b6112dfdc> { ?extraSession a prov:Activity . FILTER(?extraSession != <urn:kg-mnp:review-session:31320e54bffc59d49da5f53af3b0df63e2ff9e4808f3e9c238a8726a6df10705>) } } FILTER NOT EXISTS { GRAPH <urn:kg-mnp:graph:review-audit:a952de54abc91ebfbeea0496ac11ccc9a29e988972500fe78e20ff4b6112dfdc> { ?extraReviewer a prov:Agent . queries.10-no-blank-nodes:
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
